composting._comment_product_price_calculation: ECUA bulk biosolids compost: 10 USD/yd3 / (0.764554857984 m3/yd3 * 600 kg/m3 / 1000 kg/metric tonne) = 21.799177 USD per wet metric tonne in current 2026 dollars. Finished density 600 kg/m3 is an explicit assumption, independent of pile density.
composting._comment_product_price_deflation: 2020 USD per wet metric tonne = 21.799177 * 104.635 / 131.579 = 17.335265. PCEPI 2020 = 104.635 matches the HTL/QSDsan index table; August 2026 = 131.579 is the latest monthly proxy available as of 2026-10-28. The product_price_usd_t input is already deflated; do not deflate it again.
composting._comment_product_price_references: Compost price: https://www.ecua.fl.gov/174/Composting ; PCEPI: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/data/PCEPI ; accessed 2026-10-28.

product_price_reference.density_basis: Scenario assumption at modeled finished moisture; independent of pile density.
product_price_reference.dollar_basis: Constant 2020 USD, deflated with PCEPI as in HTL process settings.
product_price_reference.conversion: 2020 USD/wet metric tonne = source_price_usd_yd3 / (0.764554857984 * finished_bulk_density_kg_m3 / 1000) * target_pcepi / source_pcepi. product_price_usd_t is the authoritative input and is already deflated; do not deflate again.
product_price_reference.price_index: PCEPI (2017=100); same series as qsdsan.utils.indices.tea_indices["PCEPI"] used in HTL
product_price_reference.index_period_basis: Latest available monthly PCEPI used as proxy for current listed price; full-year 2026 index unavailable.

notes: Capacity is 110 dry US short tons/day using the legacy 907.185 kg/short-ton and 0.9 uptime hourly conversion. Wet rates are derived internally from sample moisture for all technologies; project operating days remain the shared TEA setting.
Four LHS multipliers perturb each recipe component on its dry basis; dry fractions are normalized and moisture and wet blending weights stay fixed.
Variation 0.1 means relative +/-10% before closure. Realized closed fractions need not remain inside the unnormalized bounds.
Green feedstock is the explicit bulking proxy; PaCTEA uses lumped carbohydrates unless detailed fractions are provided.
AD biodegradability is COD-weighted across the sampled component feeds. Source factors remain fixed literature proxies.
HTL separates 1% light, 69% biofuel additive and 30% binder as an explicit scenario. Biofuel additive uses the native diesel USD/GGE price multiplied by its HHV GGE/kg.

AD digestate sales default to zero. Compost uses a current US biosolids-compost price scenario; edit composting.product_price_usd_t in USD/wet metric tonne and marketable_fraction for the actual outlet. The compost price is deflated to 2020 USD with PCEPI; reference metadata records the latest-month 2026 proxy. AD electricity inherits the HTL tariff, already in 2020 USD; digestate price remains zero. All product-price and economics overrides must be in 2020 USD.
First-run LCA reuses HTL electricity/steam factors and explicitly excludes listed missing activities. Reported impacts are partial utility-only screening results; no technology ranking is enabled.

Native AD/compost SanUnit hooks calculate scaled installed-only capital; FOB/BM split remains unavailable. Common HTL CEPCI and electricity tariff are enforced. Open process, equipment, product and boundary gaps prevent fair-comparison differences by default.

Every sample runs HTL, AD-CHP (ad), AD-RNG (ad_rng), and composting. AD-RNG inherits AD LCA factors/exclusions unless route-specific entries are supplied. RNG compression/treatment capital uses EPA Table 4-10 as an LFG proxy for AD gas, not an NREL quotation; RNG price is a 2020-USD scenario without RIN/LCFS credits.

ad_rng._comment_rng_capital_reference: EPA LMOP January 2024, Table 4-10: 8300 USD/scfm at 1000 scfm and 6200 USD/scfm at 6000 scfm, 2020 USD. Log-log interpolation/extrapolation of total compression/treatment capital through both endpoints. Inlet is biogas after methane leakage and internal boiler use, before upgrading recovery. Nm3/h = scfm * 60 * 0.028316846592 * 273.15 / 288.7055556; scf assumed dry at 60 F and 1 atm, Nm3 at 0 C and 1 atm. Flow outside 1000-6000 scfm is flagged. LFG proxy for AD gas; pipeline/interconnection separate. https://www.epa.gov/system/files/documents/2024-01/pdh_full.pdf
